name: Ledger row reveal
looks: A short ranked data table builds row by row under a blunt headline stating the finding: a rank, a label with a dim sub-label, a colour-coded status pill, and a right-aligned value per row, landing top to bottom on a stagger. The worst rows (dead, zero, missing) are tinted in the warning colour so the damage reads at a glance.
build: Each row is a flex line (rank, label + sub-label, status pill, value) revealing on y:6px->0, opacity 0->1, staggered 0.06-0.09s, power2.out. A bad-status row tints its pill, value and a faint background strip in the warning colour; the headline above lands just before the rows start.
prompt: Under a blunt one-line finding, build a short ranked table row by row: a rank, a label, a status pill and a value, staggered top to bottom. Pick out the worst rows in the accent colour so the damage reads at a glance, and hold the finished table a beat before cutting away.
